_about: lrckit does NOT read this file. It lists every setting with its built-in default.
To change settings, create ~/.config/lrckit/config.json (or pass --config FILE)
with only the keys you want to change; everything else keeps its default. Example:
Keys starting with an underscore, like this one, are comments and ignored.
Built-in artist aliases are in lrckit/aliases.json; add your own under "aliases".
lrckit --list-aliases shows every alias group in effect.
_aliases: Your own artist alias groups, added to the built-in ones in lrckit/aliases.json (groups sharing a name are merged). Each group lists names of one artist, e.g. [["Hoshino Gen", "星野源"]].

cleaning._feature_regex: Removes '(feat. X)' / '[ft. X]' from titles and artists before searching.
cleaning._trailing_feature_regex: Removes a trailing ' feat. X' without brackets.
cleaning._korean_bracket_regex: Removes bracketed Korean subtitles, e.g. 'Love Scenario (사랑을 했다)'.
cleaning._ignore_words_artist_match: Words ignored when comparing artist names word by word.
cleaning._strip_all_brackets: true removes everything in (...) and [...] from title, artist and album before searching, e.g. member lists: 'Group ("A", "B")'. Also drops '(Live)'.

api._netease_search_limit: How many NetEase songs to fetch lyrics for per search.
api._retry_backoff: Backoff factor between retries, in seconds.
api._duration_tolerance_seconds: Allowed length difference for a confident (automatic) match.
api._syncedlyrics_timeout_seconds: How long to wait for the syncedlyrics scrapers.
api._syncedlyrics_as_fallback: true runs the syncedlyrics scrapers only when LRCLIB and NetEase find no synced lyrics that fit; false runs them with every search.
api._syncedlyrics_providers: Sources syncedlyrics may use, in its own order. LRCLIB and NetEase are left out because lrckit asks them directly; [] lets syncedlyrics use all of its sources.
api._batch_delay_seconds: Pause between tracks in batch mode, to go easy on LRCLIB.
api._enable_syncedlyrics: Search via syncedlyrics (needs the optional package).
api._enable_musicbrainz: true asks MusicBrainz whether a track is instrumental, for files tagged with a MusicBrainz recording ID (Picard). One extra request per track, at most one per second.

settings._supported_extensions: File types to scan; can only narrow the five supported ones.
settings._preview_lines: Lines shown in the short lyrics preview.
settings._non_latin_ratio_threshold: Share of lyric lines with non-Latin letters above which lyrics count as original script (0.1 = 10%).
settings._max_search_depth: Directory levels to scan below the start folder.
settings._max_file_count: Stop the scan above this many files; 0 = no limit.
settings._search_cache_entries: Searches kept in memory per session.
settings._prefer_latin: true ranks romanized lyrics first; false leaves the script out of the ranking.
settings._prefer_synced: true ranks synced lyrics above plain ones, even above an exact match with plain lyrics only.
settings._sort_by_tags: true sorts by disc/track number, false by file name.
settings._write_sidecar_lrc: Also write a .lrc file next to each track.
settings._id3_v2_version: ID3v2 version (3 or 4) for MP3s without a tag; existing tags keep theirs.
settings._uslt_language: Three-letter language code stored with MP3 lyrics.
settings._romanization_layout: What Enter picks after romanizing: "replace" or "below" (keep the original line).
settings._prefer_album_artist: true searches with the album artist instead of the track artist.
settings._search_all_aliases: true searches every alias of the artist right away. false (default) searches the tag's artist first and the aliases only when that finds no synced lyrics, or on 'a'.
